title: Yang's Electricity
description: A brand new electricity mod which based on mining and creativity!Try now!
body:
Yang's Electricity 是一款专注于电力系统的 Fabric 生态模组，专为 1.20.1 版本设计。通过引入矿石资源、电子元件和多功能方块，模组构建了一套完整且独立的能源体系，旨在通过电力驱动特殊功能：

✅ 量产化生产：利用电实现高效资源转化

✅ 强化装备：制造高威力武器与实用工具（具体功能待解锁）

核心特性​

能源基建系统​

多类型矿石开采与精炼（含导电材料）

标准化电子元件合成（导线/电阻/电池等）

可扩展电力网络架构

特色功能模块​

▶️ 武器强化工作站（需搭配相应工作方块）

▶️ 环境交互装置（未来开放红石联动）

技术扩展性​

兼容主流工业模组（计划支持热力膨胀/机械动力）

未来更新计划
v0.9.9（目前）：基础矿石、工作方块​

v1.1.0（近期）：基础电力网络搭建工具

v1.2.0（中期）：武器强化系统与自动化拆除功能

v1.3.0（长期）：跨维度能源传输研究

English Version(for reference only): \
Yang's Electricity is a Fabric-based mod designed for Minecraft 1.20.1, focusing on creating a self-contained electrical system through ore resources, electronic components, and multi-functional blocks. It aims to enhance gameplay by introducing electricity-driven mechanics:

✓ Mass Production: Efficiently convert resources using electrical systems.

✓ Equipment Enhancement: Forge high-powered weapons and tools (features unlocking soon).

Core Features​

Energy Infrastructure​

Ore mining and refining (including conductive materials).

Standardized electronic component synthesis (wires/resistors/batteries).

Scalable power grid architecture.

Feature Modules​

✓ Weapon Enhancement Station​ (requires paired workstation blocks).

▶️ Environmental Interaction Tools​ (Redstone integration planned).

Technical Expandability​

Compatibility with major industrial mods (e.g., Thermal Expansion, IndustrialCraft).

Open API for community mods.

Update Roadmap​

v1.1.0 (Near-term): Basic power network construction tools.

v1.2.0 (Mid-term): Weapon enhancement systems + automated demolition.

v1.3.0 (Long-term): Cross-dimensional energy transmission research.
